description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the PersonVoidHandler class, which handles voiding (soft deleting) Person entities in the OpenMRS system. The tests cover setting voided flags, reasons, voided by user, date voided, preventing overwriting if already voided, and retiring associated users.

classes.name: PersonVoidHandlerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the PersonVoidHandler's handling of voiding Person objects within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetThePersonVoidedBit
methods.description: Tests that the handle method sets the person's voided boolean flag to true.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetThePersonVoidReason
methods.description: Verifies that handle sets the person void reason to the provided string.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetPersonVoidedBy
methods.description: Checks that handle assigns the correct User as the person voided by.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetPersonVoidedByIfNonNull
methods.description: Ensures that handle does not overwrite an existing personVoidedBy user.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetPersonDateVoided
methods.description: Confirms that handle sets the date the person was voided.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetPersonDateVoidedIfNonNull
methods.description: Verifies that handle does not overwrite the existing date voided if already set.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetThePersonVoidReasonIfAlreadyPersonVoided
methods.description: Checks that void reason is not set if the person is already marked as voided.

methods.name: handle_shouldRetireUsers
methods.description: Tests that associated User accounts are retired (removed) when a Person is voided.
